version_non_testee.title: SolisArt: untested controller version
version_non_testee.description:
The controller {carte} runs software {version_carte} with web interface {version_web}, a combination missing from the list of tested versions ({versions_testees}).

Reading goes on as usual, but modes, setpoints and schedules can no longer be changed from Home Assistant. Every change sends back the whole User page form, and on this version it could alter other settings without anyone noticing.

If everything looks right on your side, open an issue with these two versions so they can be added to the list. You can also allow changes in the integration options, at your own risk.
